capabilities: Rename the current note or the embed/link under the cursor with F2
Edit wikilink aliases and markdown image alt text while renaming their targets
Edit configured frontmatter properties via F2 and the full frontmatter block via F5
Rename companion files with the same basename together
Rename files from the file explorer context menu and copy the new basename to the clipboard
extras: Not yet in the community catalog; the README recommends installing via BRAT or manually copying built files. Runs fully offline with no network requests or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian's built-in rename requires the file explorer or menus, and offers no way to rename an embedded file or edit its alias directly from the cursor.

relations.evidence: Excalidraw — edit the stem without .excalidraw / .excalidraw.md, restore on save

summary: Keyboard-driven rename panel that renames the current note, embeds, links, and companion files, and edits frontmatter properties from the cursor.
